title: FQTree: Fine-grained Quantization and Hardware Generation of Boosted Decision Trees
abstract: arXiv:2608.12140v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Boosted decision trees (BDTs) are widely used in latency-critical applications, but efficient hardware deployment remains challenging. Existing designs often rely on uniform or manually tuned fixed-point formats, which can introduce unnecessary hardware cost or accuracy loss. This work presents the FQTree algorithm{https://github.com/ecs-bristol/FQTree} for fine-grained quantization-aware training of BDTs, together with the QXGB framework for automatic hardware generation. FQTree introduces a hardware-oriented leaf-value quantization scheme that uses a global quantization step together with a tree-wise shift, enabling compact non-negative integer leaf representations, controlled clipping/pruning, and bias folding to reduce datapath cost. translated_title: FQTree：提升决策树的细粒度量化与硬件生成
translated_abstract: 提升决策树（BDTs）广泛应用于延迟敏感型应用中，但高效的硬件部署仍具挑战性。现有设计通常依赖统一或手动调整的定点格式，这可能导致不必要的硬件成本或精度损失。本工作提出了FQTree算法（https://github.com/ecs-bristol/FQTree），用于BDTs的细粒度量化感知训练，并提供了QXGB框架用于自动硬件生成。FQTree引入了一种面向硬件的叶值量化方案，该方案使用全局量化步长和树级移位，实现了紧凑的非负整数叶表示、可控的裁剪/剪枝以及偏置折叠以降低数据路径成本。本工作还在提升过程中应用此量化，使后续树适应已量化集成的误差，然后将训练模型转化为低延迟硬件实现。
tldr: 本文提出FQTree算法和QXGB框架，通过细粒度量化感知训练和自动硬件生成，实现了提升决策树的高效低延迟硬件部署。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the FQTree algorithm and QXGB framework, enabling efficient low-latency hardware deployment of boosted decision trees through fine-grained quantization-aware training and automatic hardware generation.
